dedupe_keys.name: huangtu dataset 1 0 very high resolution imagery and land cover labels for rural waste collection planning sichuan china

description: This image set helps map villages, roads and farmland in a hilly rural township of south-west China so that household waste collection points and truck routes can be planned. The producers are Xi Cheng and Jieyu Yang of Chengdu University of Technology, and the data accompany their paper on optimising rural waste management with high-resolution remote sensing and GIS. Coverage is Huangtu Town in Sichuan Province, a sparsely populated area with complex terrain, in 30 image blocks of 1,000 by 1,000 pixels at one metre resolution taken from 2020 imagery. Each block has a pixel-level land cover label with buildings, roads, forest, farmland, water and background, and a separate farmland boundary label, suited to training segmentation models that locate settlements and road access. The zip archive is available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: a small sample of one township, a single year, and no waste quantities or routes are included in the deposit itself. Simulation uses: extracting rural road networks and settlements to design collection routes and site transfer points. Related records: the dumped waste UAV detection model (model-dumped-waste-uav-detection) also applies imagery to waste management.
